title: Effect of pegylated nano niosomal 2, 4- dichlorophenoxyacetic acid on intracellular taxol production
protocol: Add 4 mg l<sup>-1</sup> 2.4-D, 2 mg l<sup>-1</sup> kin, 2 gr l<sup>-1</sup> activated charcoal, 30 mg l<sup>-1</sup> sucrose, and 7 gr l<sup>-1</sup> of agar into B5 media.
Adjust the pH to 5.8-6 for the B5 cell culture media.
Add 4 mg l<sup>-1</sup> 2.4-D, 0.5 mg l<sup>-1</sup> kin, and 30 mg l<sup>-1</sup> sucrose into B5 media for cell suspension media.
Mix absolute ethanol and H<sub>2</sub>O at a ratio of 70 ethanol:30 H<sub>2</sub>O (v/v) to prepare 70% ethanol.
Mix sodium hypochlorite (5%) and H<sub>2</sub>O at a ratio of 50 sodium hypochlorite (5%): 50 H<sub>2</sub>O ml (v/v) to prepare 2.5% sodium hypochloride.
Dissolve 30 mg cholesterol in 30 ml ethanol for preparation of pegylated nano niosomal 2,4-D.
Add span20, tween20, and PEG3000 according to Table 1 to the above solution.
Add 5 mg 2,4-D to the solution containing cholesterol and surfactants.
Allow the reactants to react for 30 minutes at room temperature on a magnetite stirrer at 120 rpm.
Evaporate the solvent by rotary evaporator.
Add 50 ml sterilized distilled water to the gel containing 2,4-D.
Subject the obtained suspension containing 2,4-D to sonication by an ultra sonic sonicator.
Pass the suspension through a filter of 0.22 µm to obtain uniform niosomes.
Mix methanol and hydrochloric acid at a ratio of 75 methanol:25 hydrochloric acid (v/v) for extraction medium.
Mix methanol, H2O, and acetonitrile at a ratio of 5:35:60 (v/v).
Filter the solution before use.
Soak the samples in a water dish containing dishwashing liquid for sterilization.
Place the samples under running water for 20 minutes.
Wash the explants with 70% ethanol for 1 minute.
Transfer the samples to a sodium hypochlorite solution (2.5%) containing two drops of Tween 20 for 15 minutes.
Wash the samples with sterilized distilled water three times, each time for 15 minutes.
Dry the explants on filter paper.
Transfer the lateral meristem into B5 media containing 2,4-D (4 mg/L), Kin (0.5 mg/L), and activated charcoal (2 g/L).
Incubate the samples at 25°C in complete darkness for a month.
Subculture the explants into B5 media containing 2.4-D at 4 mg/L.
Add Kin to the B5 media at a concentration of 0.5 mg/L.
Include activated charcoal in the B5 media at 2 g/L.
Incubate the explants at 25°C in complete darkness for one month.
Measure the dry weight of callus traits.
Determine the fresh weight of callus traits.
Assess the callus surface area.
Evaluate the callus mass.
Calculate the percentage of surviving cells.
Add 2 g of callus biomass to 50 ml cell suspension medium.
Incubate the cell suspension at 25°C and 130 rpm in complete darkness.
Take 1 ml of cell suspension every day for growth phase determination.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 13000 rpm for 10 min.
Wash the cells with sterile distilled water three times.
Weigh out the cells to determine logarithmic growth phase.
Add nanoparticles into the cell suspension media during the logarithmic phase.
Remove cells by centrifugation at 13000 rpm after 96 hours.
Discard the supernatant from the precipitated cells.
Transfer the precipitated cells to a 2 ml tube.
Homogenize 1 g of samples with 1 ml extraction buffer.
Place the homogenate at room temperature for one hour.
Vortex the homogenate every five minutes.
Remove cell debris by centrifugation at 12000 rpm for ten minutes.
Transfer the supernatant to a new tube.
Filter the extract through filter paper with a 0.22 µm pore size.
Use the filtered extract to determine Taxol content by HPLC method.
